module_summary: Single-stage valid/ready stream register: load-enabled flops capture valid and data when downstream is ready or the stage is empty, with synchronous clear.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Registered output valid; loaded from valid_i when ready_o, marks the stage full

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Upstream ready: asserted when downstream ready or register empty; enables valid flop

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Registered payload loaded from data_i when reg_ena; drives output data

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Upstream valid; loaded into valid_o and qualifies data register enable

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready; frees the stage and drives ready_o

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload captured into data_o on accepted transfer

anchors.name: reg_ena
anchors.why: Data register load enable: valid_i AND ready_o

groups.name: handshake_control
groups.description: Computes ready_o and load enable, tracks stage occupancy in valid_o

groups.name: data_stage
groups.description: Load-enabled data register between input and output streams
